prompt: Spring Boot Undertow access log %D response time prerequisite
answer:
For Undertow, enable request start-time recording for `%D` response time to work:

```properties
server.undertow.accesslog.enabled=true
server.undertow.accesslog.pattern=%t %a %r %s (%D ms)
server.undertow.options.server.record-request-start-time=true
```

Equivalent YAML:

```yaml
server:
  undertow:
    accesslog:
      enabled: true
      pattern: "%t %a %r %s (%D ms)"
    options:
      server:
        record-request-start-time: true
```

`%D` reports the response time in microseconds, despite the example’s `ms` label. (Search results 1–2.)
